technical-data.invention-title: WIND MACHINE FOR HARVESTING AND GATHERING OLIVES
MACHINE PNEUMATIQUE POUR LA RECOLTE ET LE RAMASSAGE DES OLIVES

abstract.p: The machine object of the present invention produces a directed and controlled air stream of the swirl type action over the crown of the tree causing the fall of the olives. The machine is essentially composed by a set of two concentric spherical caps (1 and 2) for conducting the wind and orienting its distribution being one external (1) fixed provided with openings (3) for supplying compressed air directed to the internal movable cap (2) with shots (12) conveniently directed and provided of a vane set (6) in its internal surface and a vane set (7) in its external surface. This cap (2) is connected to the external cap (1) by a fixing axle around which rotates by the effect of the compressed air flow against the vanes (6 and 7) of the internal cap (2). Around the external cap (1) is attached a skirt (9) which is disposed over and all around the tree and where the olives fall down then led to the storage tank by means of a flexible pipe or sleeve.

Cette machine produit un courant d'air, du type tourbillonnaire, commandé et dirigé sur la couronne de l'arbre, ce qui entraîne la chute des olives. Cette machine est principalement constituée d'un jeu de deux chapeaux sphériques concentriques (1 et 2) conduisant le mouvement de l'air et l'orientant. Le chapeau extérieur (1) comporte des orifices (3) fournissant l'air comprimé dirigé vers le chapeau intérieur mobile (2) par des fentes (12) convenablement orientées. Ce chapeau intérieur est pourvu d'un volet (6) sur sa face interne et d'un volet (7) sur sa face externe. Ce chapeau (2) est relié au chapeau extérieur (1) par un axe de fixation autour duquel il tourne sous l'effet de l'air comprimé portant sur les volets (6 et 7). Autour du chapeau extérieur (1) se trouve une jupe (9), placée sur l'arbre et l'entourant, dans laquelle les olives tombent. Ces dernières sont ensuite amenées dans un réservoir de stockage à l'aide d'un tuyau souple ou d'un manchon.

description.p: DESCRIPTION
'Wind Machine for harvesting and gathering olives'

At present, the mechanical harvesting of olives makes use of two kind of agricultural machines. The first kind that will be called "vibrator" holds the olive tree by the trunk and causes its fruits - the olives - to detach by means of vibration and to fall down onto the ground, more precisely onto the cloths placed around the olive tree. The second kind uses vertical poles that knock the olive tree horizontally. Such poles are seated vertically on a mechanical vibrating platform. The lateral pole knocking causes the fruits of the olive tree - the olives - to fall vertically onto the cloths placed on the ground around the tree to be gathered afterwards.

In both kinds of machines, the gathering of the olives is an operation posterior to the mechanical operation of harvest. In both kinds of machines the physical action of the machine is applied on the olive tree which is shaken or knocked.

A search of the state of the art has revealed the existence of Portuguese patents No. 91416 e No. 96472 to Verdegiglio; No. 94709 to Luis G. M. Zoio and Johanna W.V. Mourik; the US patent 5 437 146 to Erickson M. C. and the German patent DE 3006177 to (PIRE) Industrie Pirelli SPA.

The machine object of the present invention differs from any other kind of machine in use. It does not exert any physical action upon the tree. It produces a directed and controlled air stream of the swirl type, that causes the natural fall of the olives into a bag or skirt that belongs to the machine itself, leaving through the collecting pipe of the skirt into a storage container or tank that then convey the olives directly to a depot or olive press. The gathering is made by means of the machine object of the present invention that will now be described.
The machine object of the present invention can also be useful to harvest other kinds of fruits and even for further purposes. In effect,

-1 - SUBSTTTUTE SHEET (RULE 26)
advantage can be taken of the generation of the low intensity swirl, for example, for the treatment of other species of trees and against any kind of plagues, by spraying the trees with any kind of suitable product, thus increasing their economical value.
1 - Composition
The main element is comprised by a set of two concentric spherical caps (1 and 2) for condensing the wind and orienting its distribution:

- The external fixed spherical cap (1) provided with a holding hoop (externally held by a lifting machine (crane type), with openings (3) for supplying compressed air conveyed through a feed pipe (4) to its inside, supplied from a motor driven air compressor. This spherical cap can be made in hard aluminium or any other suitable material.
In the external spherical cap (1) are embedded telescopic bars (8) for up support of the skirt (9).
The internal spherical cap (2) movable around a fixing axle (5) that connects it to the external spherical cap (1) leaving between them a space for receiving the compressed air.

The internal spherical cap (2) has a vane set (6) in its external surface and a vane set (7) in its internal surface, the external surface vanes (6) having a larger size than the internal surface vanes (7).

Further to the vanes the internal spherical cap (2) has slots or slits (12) conveniently directed for the generation of the swirl. The internal spherical cap (2) can be made in moulded brass or plastics.
Skirt

Attached all around to the outer periphery of the external spherical cap (1) by means of holding straps is a skirt which can be made of a suitable transparent material, such as a transparent polyvinyl or other suitable material. The skirt is disposed closed all around the tree, for enclosing the swirl for sufficient time to cause the fruits (olives) to fall. The fruits are conveyed to the exterior of the skirt by means of a flexible collection pipe or sleeve (10).
The holding straps will have eyelets that will direct the skirt gathering threads while changing it from the tree.
2 - Secondary parts
A motor driven air compressor with controlled variable intensity flow.
A lifting machine (crane) for lifting and holding the two spherical caps and skirt set over the tree - "olive tree" - and carrying the compressed air feed pipe for the spherical caps.
A wheeled stable platform (trailer) will carry along the olive tree plantation the motor driven compressor, the lifting machine, the skirt and spherical caps set and the olive storage tank.
Operation Mode

The set is placed over the tree by means of the lifting machine extending the telescopic bars (8) embedded in the external spherical cap (1) such that the area covered by the spherical caps and skirt set can be enlarged to the dimension suitable to the crown of the tree. Bars (8) are autonomously adjustable according to the irregularities of the crowns. The skirt (9) is then held and fastened onto the trunk of the tree directing the sleeve to the storage tank.

The spherical caps (1 and 2) are fed with compressed air having controlled variable pressure. When the air impacts on the outer vanes (6) of the internal spherical cap (2), this will rotate thus increasing the air pressure and the air is conveyed to the inside through the slots (12). Then the air is spread and directed in swirl by the other inner vanes (7) of smaller size.

The swirl or windstorm thus generated inside the skirt causes the fruits (olives) to detach and fall down onto the base of the skirt (9) then leading them to the storage tank by means of the flexible pipe or sleeve (10) together with the already dissipating swirl that will leave to the outside.
Flow control will produce the swirl or windstorm in quantity, velocity and strength adequate to the harvesting operation.
The harvesting operation can be conducted by two men only.

claim.claim-text: 1. Wind machine for harvesting olives, in combination with a skirt, which surrounds, in use, the tree, the skirt being provided with a sleeve for exiting and gathering the fruits, characterised in that the machine is powered by air compressed and is provided in its main body with a set of two concentric spherical caps (1 and 2), connected to each other by a common connecting axle (5), leaving a space between them, the external one (1) being fixed and being provided with one lateral opening (3), that inputs an compressed air flow and the other one (2) being mobile and rotates around the common axle (5) under the effect of the compressed air flow and is provided with directed slots or slits (12) and provided with vanes (6 and 7) along its inner and outer surfaces.

2. Wind machine as set forth in claim 1 , characterised in that the external spherical cap (1) has embedded autonomously telescopic bars (8) for supporting the skirt (9) which covers the tree according with the size of its crown.

3. Wind machine as set forth in claim 1 and 2, characterised in that the skirt (9) for enclosing the tree is held in the external spherical cap (1), being fixed to the cap by means of an holding hoop or straps, and having a gathering flexible sleeve or pipe (10) to convey the olives to the storage tank and simultaneously the compressed air to the outside.

4. Wind machine as set forth in claims 1 , 2 and 3, characterised in that the external spherical cap (1) is lifted by a lifting machine or crane and fed with compressed air by the feed pipes (4) connected to its lateral openings.
